plan.summary: Fix os.fchmod Unix-only issue by adding platform check with hasattr

tdd_steps.description: Add test_save_works_without_fchmod that mocks os.fchmod to raise AttributeError (simulating Windows)
Add hasattr check before calling os.fchmod in storage.py

verification_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_issue_5913_windows_fchmod.py

implementation.approach: Add hasattr(os, 'fchmod') check before calling os.fchmod to skip the permission setting on Windows where fchmod is unavailable. This is a minimal fix that maintains Unix permission behavior while allowing Windows compatibility.
